style: High-detail stylised 3D render, like a premium isometric city-builder or management game: physically based materials with real texture (brick, weathered paint, glass reflections, concrete, worn asphalt, foliage), soft global illumination, ambient occlusion, warm late-afternoon sun from the top left casting soft shadows to the bottom right, lived-in small details (wear, stains, plants, clutter, signage shapes), rich but natural colours, gentle depth of field. Characters are stylised but believable, with a dry sense of humour. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermark. One consistent camera and art direction across the whole set.
